description_ru: Organic deposits: peat and muck, commonly <1 m; ice-wedge polygons
Alluvial deposits: gravel to silt, floodplains and fans, 1-5 m
Littoral sediments: medium to coarse sand with pebbles, 1-3 m
Marine blanket: silt and clay with minor sand, 2-30 m; segregated ice, thaw slumps
Marine veneer: <2 m, infilling depressions between bedrock outcrops
Glaciomarine and marine deltas: sand, gravel, cobbles, 5-20 m
Outwash: rounded gravel and sand, 2-20 m
Esker sediments: sand, silt and gravel ridges
Till veneer: <2 m, rock structure visible
Bedrock: flow basalt and gabbro sills
